components.gap: Sort predicates Q_s, guard translation, nonemptiness axioms and disjointness axioms are explicit (variants.tex:106-152) and the assignment guard is explicit (154-172), but no coverage convention is stated in the reduction: Ax_sort and its commentary (126-148) never say whether the one-sorted domain must be covered by the Q_s, why a coverage axiom is omitted (e.g. not first-order expressible with infinitely many sorts), or that its omission is harmless; the only trace is the informal remark 'extra one-sorted elements are ignored by the guards' (195-196) and the junk point in the construction (191-193). The component explicitly asks for coverage/disjointness/nonemptiness conventions.

Theorem statement (variants.tex:174-189) and proof (higher-order-supplement.tex:22-60) exist, but the proof steps are not all written: (a) the term-level induction claim (well-sorted term values agree between the many-sorted and one-sorted structures) is invoked but never stated in either direction (32-33, 55-56); (b) the formula induction in the first direction gives only atomic and quantifier cases in one sentence (39-41), Boolean cases not mentioned; (c) the converse direction's satisfaction correspondence is asserted only as 'The same induction gives truth preservation' (55-56) with no stated claim relating M,s to the tagged structure and tagged assignment and no cases, even though the tagged structure differs (junk point, other-sort elements under the guards); (d) in the converse, 'The four sort-axiom families hold' is asserted without verification and satisfaction of VarGuard_MS by the tagged assignment is never mentioned although it is one of the premises of the right side.

Composite: GOAL-02 (coverage convention not explicit) and GOAL-03 (converse induction, term induction, axiom/VarGuard verification not written) are partial, so the bounded composite is not fully supplied.
